title: FormulaSPIN：自然语言到电子表格公式生成的自对弈微调
summary: FormulaSPIN是一个自对弈框架，通过利用公式的可执行性作为隐式监督，解决了传统监督微调在电子表格公式生成任务中数据饱和的问题。它采用双玩家游戏和自适应课程学习，从语义正确性过渡到风格优化，并引入ExecVote投票机制处理多种有效公式。在NL2FORMULA基准上达到74.9%精确匹配和87.1%执行准确率，超越传统SFT和前沿专有模型。
summary_en: FormulaSPIN is a self-play framework that leverages formula executability as implicit supervision to overcome data saturation in supervised fine-tuning for spreadsheet formula generation. It uses a two-player game with adaptive curriculum learning and ExecVote mechanism, achieving 74.9% exact match and 87.1% execution accuracy on NL2FORMULA, outperforming traditional SFT and frontier proprietary models.
